title: Cat's Eye Is Here
overview: The Cat's Eye sisters Hitomi, Rui, and Ai outwit Detective Toshio to steal the "Roman Woman."

title: Memory of Dad
overview: Hitomi pursues the painting "A Girl from One Day,""despite the extreme security and risks involved.

title: Difficult Love
overview: Hitomi and Rui plan to steal from the Ohashi Museum of Art despite Ai's objections.

title: Night Flight Is a Dangerous Scent
overview: Hitomi is concerned about their next heist, as Detective Asatani's suspicious gaze follows her.

title: Gentleman Thief Is Here!
overview: Kamiya, a jewel thief, becomes intrigued by Hitomi and uses a bet with Ai to get close to her.

title: I Wish We Could Stay As We Are
overview: Hitomi's role in Cat's Eye strains her relationship with Toshio, her lover and a detective.

title: Stay Out of the Diary!
overview: Though hesitant at first, the sisters let Toshio stay at Cat's Eye café.

title: Dad's Self-Portrait
overview: The sisters plan to stop Toshio's demotion by sending a fake heist notice to the police.

title: Get the Goddess of Mars
overview: When Seguchi announces the display of "The Goddess of Mars," Cat's Eye plots to steal the painting.

title: First Date in a While
overview: The Cat's Eye sisters infiltrate Toyo Foundation's remote island to recover their father's painting.

title: An Invitation from Runan Island
overview: Hitomi faces a grueling survival challenge on Toyo Foundation's island.

title: The Promise of Sunset
overview: Kaibara reveals Cat's Eye's true identity and demands they return all of Cranaff's paintings.
